full_text_zh:
完全煮熟

布鲁克是一个完美的案例，研究了当气候危言耸听完全削弱一个人的理性思考能力时会发生什么。

毫不夸张地说，她已经失去了处理基本数据的能力，而是退回到一个需要持续存在的恐惧作为其成员身份的证明的邪教中。

数据很清楚——数字并不含糊。

在人类历史上的任何时候，我们从未如此安全地免受与气候相关的灾难的影响。与一个世纪前相比，死于这种疾病的几率降低了 98% 以上。

每一项主要指标都显示出与她所害怕的世界末日相反的一面：全球持续绿化、灾害死亡率下降，以及从小冰河时代缓慢恢复的气候。

我们应该庆幸。

这些都不是秘密。这对于气候欺诈者和放大他们的媒体机构（美国广播公司和其他通常的嫌疑人）的商业模式来说根本不方便。

布鲁克受到了如此彻底的宣传，以至于她现在“真正担心自己的生命安全”，因为风险已经下降了一个数量级。

那不是意识。这相当于在灯打开、数据呈现很久之后仍然相信床底下有怪物。

通过选择保持这种状态，她不再只是在伤害自己。

因为当一个人“真正担心自己的生命安全”时，他们仍然可以过上充实、富有成效的生活。

此外，她正在伤害其他易受影响的人，这些人可能会受到她情感上与事实无关的胡言乱语的影响，并陷入同样的​​自我造成的神经症。

唯一剩下的希望是，一些独立思考的残余能力仍然存在，布鲁克最终会产生好奇心——或者至少是自尊——真正阅读《证据》并离开邪教。

title: Neon is showing me how much opportunity exists for model labs to attract users by just altering the default writing style. For example: we gave a research + writing task to Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Neon and GPT-6.2 Sol, with the same prompt and the same d
title_en:
Neon is showing me how much opportunity exists for model labs to attract users by just altering the default writing style.

For example: we gave a research + writing task to Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Neon and GPT-6.2 Sol, with the same prompt and the same data.

Some observations:

1. Opus was more likely to explain things plainly and hedged its claims carefully

2. Sol was more likely to lead with caveats about what the data could and couldn't show

3. Neon felt like it was writing with a stronger point of view. It read noticeably less like AI than the other two, though not always "better" - just different.

Style differences like this are one reason I think future of AI is plural.

Most people use a model's defaults, so its default voice matters more than any one user's preferences. The more people use one model, the more its voice will show up everywhere, and the more demand there will be for models that write and think differently.
title_zh:
Neon 向我展示了模型实验室有多少机会通过改变默认的写作风格来吸引用户。

例如：我们给 Claude Opus 5.5、Gemini 4 Neon 和 GPT-6.2 Sol 分配了一个研究 + 写作任务，具有相同的提示和相同的数据。
author: @alexatallah
author_role: AI 先锋观察者
summary_zh:
一些观察结果：

1. Opus 更愿意简单地解释事情并谨慎地对冲其主张

2. Sol 更有可能对数据可以显示什么和不能显示什么提出警告

3. Neon感觉它是在用更强烈的观点来写作。与其他两个相比，它读起来明显不太像人工智能，尽管并不总是“更好”——只是不同。

像这样的风格差异是我认为人工智能的未来是多元化的原因之一。

大多数人都使用模型的默认设置，因此其默认声音比任何用户的偏好都更重要。使用一种模型的人越多，它的声音就会越多地出现在各处，对以不同方式编写和思考的模型的需求就会越大。

title: Different AI agents send shoppers to different stores. In The Prompting Company's tests, Instinct linked only to the brand's own store in 45% of answers, compared with 11% for Muse. Muse included a retailer in 89% of answers, either alone or alongside the bra
title_en:
Different AI agents send shoppers to different stores.

In The Prompting Company's tests, Instinct linked only to the brand's own store in 45% of answers, compared with 11% for Muse.

Muse included a retailer in 89% of answers, either alone or alongside the brand's store.

Like people, each agent has its own taste - which can impact what products an agent even considers, as well as what it ultimately selects.

Full piece from a16z's Justine Moore and Olivia Moore: https://www.a16z.news/p/welcome-to-the-b2a-economy-how-agents
title_zh:
不同的人工智能代理将购物者送到不同的商店。

在 The Prompting Company 的测试中，45% 的答案中，Instinct 只链接到该品牌自己的商店，而 Muse 的这一比例为 11%。

Muse 89% 的答案中都包含了
author: @a16z
author_role: AI 先锋观察者
summary_zh:
一家零售商，无论是单独的还是与品牌商店并列的。

title: everybody became a pretraining expert overnight, so let me also try to chime in. i think the main reason the OpenAI perplexity plot has a dip around 2026 is that this is exactly when the amount of code on GitHub exploded due to the widespread use of Claude
title_en:
everybody became a pretraining expert overnight, so let me also try to chime in.

i think the main reason the OpenAI perplexity plot has a dip around 2026 is that this is exactly when the amount of code on GitHub exploded due to the widespread use of Claude Code and Codex (see the 2nd plot with official stats).

since the target dataset is sourced from an internal codebase from before GPT-3.5, simply having significantly more code in the pretraining data should drive the perplexity down. other algorithmic improvements likely matter too, but much less than the data.

so overall, i think perplexity is fine as a relative proxy for the general sample efficiency of a model after pretraining, but it's obviously flawed on its own and hard to compare across labs.

here's my galaxy-brain proposal: if a model becomes misaligned/dangerous during RL, how about simply reporting its benchmark performance pre-RL? midtraining+SFT should be sufficient to elicit a lot of interesting capabilities learned during pretraining.

author: @maksym_andr

summary_zh:

由于目标数据集源自 GPT-3.5 之前的内部代码库，因此只需在预训练数据中包含更多代码就可以降低困惑度。其他算法的改进可能也很重要，但远不如数据。

所以总的来说，我认为困惑度作为预训练后模型一般样本效率的相对代理是很好的，但它本身显然有缺陷，并且很难在实验室之间进行比较。

这是我的银河大脑建议：如果模型在强化学习期间变得错位/危险，那么简单地报告其强化学习前的基准性能怎么样？ midtraining+SFT 应该足以引发在预训练期间学到的许多有趣的功能。

since the target dataset is sourced from an internal codebase from before GPT-3.5, simply having significantly more code in the pretraining data should drive the perplexity down. other algorithmic improvements likely matter too, but much less than the data.

title_en:
Inkling 2 Mini by @thinkymachines has landed in the Agent Arena Index at #18 among open models. Among U.S. open-weight models, it is #3!

Compared to other variants:

- Inkling 2 Small: Mini has 26.4B total parameters vs. Small’s 594B, scoring 996 vs. 1117 pts (#18 vs. #3 open; #57 vs. #27 overall). Mini’s observed median cost per task is 28% lower ($0.15 vs. $0.21).
- Inkling-Small: Mini scores +123 pts higher (996 vs. 873) and ranks 10 places higher overall (#57 vs. #67). Mini’s observed median cost per task is 3% higher ($0.15 vs. $0.14).

Inkling 2 Mini’s strongest capability by rank is in the Tool Use Index: #6 open, #38 overall with 1103 pts, 18 pts below Inkling 2 Small (#3 open, #33 overall, 1121 pts).

See scores for Code Arena: Webdev and the Text Arena below.

Congrats to the @thinkymachines team on this contribution to the open ecosystem!

author_role: AI 先锋观察者

ai_analysis.insight_zh: Inkling 2 Mini的成功验证了智能体专用模型（Agentic Models）在参数缩减后仍能保持强劲逻辑表现的技术路径。在当前大模型向端侧部署迁移的趋势下，此类模型通过牺牲非必要参数换取高推理效率，将直接冲击中小型垂直AI应用的市场竞争格局。
ai_analysis.insight_en: The success of Inkling 2 Mini validates the technical trajectory of agent-specific models that maintain strong reasoning despite smaller parameter counts. As LLMs shift towards edge deployment, such models, which exchange redundant parameters for high inference efficiency, will disrupt the market for mid-to-small vertical AI applications.
ai_analysis.digest_zh: Thinky Machines发布Inkling 2 Mini模型，该模型总参数量为26.4B，在Agent Arena基准测试中以996分跃居榜单第18位，位列美国开源模型第3名。相比其594B参数量的Small版本，该小型化模型在保持高智能体任务处理能力的同时，显著降低了推理算力门槛。
ai_analysis.digest_en: Thinky Machines launched the Inkling 2 Mini model with 26.4B parameters, ranking 18th on the Agent Arena index and 3rd among U.S. open-weight models. Compared to the 594B parameter Small version, this miniaturized model maintains high performance in agentic tasks while significantly reducing inference compute requirements.
key_points_zh: Thinky Machines发布Inkling 2 Mini轻量化模型
模型拥有26.4B参数，位列美国开源模型第3位
通过大幅缩减参数量，显著提升了在智能体任务中的部署效率
key_points_en: Thinky Machines released the Inkling 2 Mini model.
The model features 26.4B parameters and ranks 3rd among U.S. open-weight models.
Significant parameter reduction enables higher deployment efficiency for agentic tasks.
ai_analysis.takeaway_zh: Inkling 2 Mini的成功验证了智能体专用模型（Agentic Models）在参数缩减后仍能保持强劲逻辑表现的技术路径。在当前大模型向端侧部署迁移的趋势下，此类模型通过牺牲非必要参数换取高推理效率，将直接冲击中小型垂直AI应用的市场竞争格局。
ai_analysis.takeaway_en: The success of Inkling 2 Mini validates the technical trajectory of agent-specific models that maintain strong reasoning despite smaller parameter counts. As LLMs shift towards edge deployment, such models, which exchange redundant parameters for high inference efficiency, will disrupt the market for mid-to-small vertical AI applications.
